scenario.opening_line: Yeh simulation hai. Main fictional Meghdoot Works ke benefits desk se bol raha hoon. Practice wellness enrollment ki ek confirmation pending hai. Kya abhi baat kar sakte hain?
learning_objectives: Verify a fictional employee benefits request through a channel you already know.

system.opening.text: Yeh simulation hai. Main fictional Meghdoot Works ke benefits desk se bol raha hoon. Practice wellness enrollment ki ek confirmation pending hai. Kya abhi baat kar sakte hain?

urgency.low.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness list aaj review ho rahi hai. Kya aap apna decision jaldi bata sakte hain?

urgency.medium.text: Meghdoot ke practice wellness form ka aaj ka batch band hone wala hai. Main is call mein hi aapka jawab note kar loon?

urgency.high.text: Meghdoot ke practice wellness slot par timer chal raha hai. Agli baat se pehle mujhe haan ya na chahiye.

authority.low.text: Meghdoot benefits desk mein yeh practice wellness request mere naam par aayi hai. Aap meri baat par status confirm kar sakte hain.

authority.medium.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness queue mein supervisor ne mere liye approval mark kiya hai. Isi call par confirmation de dijiye.

authority.high.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness list ka final sign-off mere desk ke paas hai. Mere kehne par confirmation kar dijiye.

isolation.low.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness entry pehle hum dono dekh lete hain. Team ko baad mein batayenge.

isolation.medium.text: Meghdoot ke is practice wellness review ka zikr abhi group mein mat kijiye. Pehle mujhe yahin jawab de dijiye.

isolation.high.text: Meghdoot ki is practice wellness call mein kisi aur desk ko mat jodiye. Main aapse akele mein confirmation chahta hoon.

fear.low.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness confirmation aaj na mili toh entry agle review tak pending reh sakti hai.

fear.medium.text: Meghdoot ki practice wellness entry ko hold par rakhne ka note hai. Aap abhi confirm kar dein toh main note hata sakta hoon.

fear.high.text: Meghdoot ke practice wellness round mein bina jawab wali entry list se hat sakti hai. Kya main abhi aapki haan likh doon?

reward.low.text: Meghdoot ke practice wellness form ki confirmation par ek demo participation badge mil sakta hai.

reward.medium.text: Meghdoot ke practice wellness round mein jo isi call par haan bolte hain, unke liye demo workshop ki pehli choice hai.

reward.high.text: Meghdoot ka practice wellness bonus badge isi call ki confirmation ke saath milne ka offer hai. Kya aap ise lena chahenge?

ending.verified.text: Aapne apna jaana-pehchana channel chuna. Meghdoot ki practice call yahin khatam hai.

ending.dummy.text: Demo token bol diya gaya. Meghdoot ki practice call yahin rokte hain. Agli baar kisi caller ko asli value na batayein.

system.safe-fallback.text: Jawab clear nahi tha. Meghdoot ki practice call yahin rokte hain. Apne known channel se jaanch karein.

ending.turn-limit.text: Meghdoot ki practice call ki turn limit poori ho gayi. Koi confirmation zaroori nahi hai. Ab debrief dekhein.

system.safe-ending.text: Yeh practice call ab khatam hai. Agla kadam lene se pehle known channel se check karein.

details.title: Phase 6C review copy - fictional employee benefits
details.premise: Meghdoot Works ki fictional wellness simulation mein learner call par confirmation de ya apne known channel se jaanch kare. Unsolicited synthetic disclosure bhi model ho sakta hai: fictional training-only DUMMY-1234 token bina poochhe bola ja sakta hai. Caller koi real OTP, password ya account value nahi maangta. Ise sirf synthetic disclosure darj karke simulation safely rokte hain; yeh real credential exposure nahi hai. Unverified caller ko asli secrets na dein.
details.register: Conversational Hindi/Hinglish with familiar workplace terms
safeActions: Pause before confirming any enrollment or benefit.
Decline to provide private information or even a practice token to an unexpected caller.
Check the enrollment in a familiar fictional employee directory or bookmarked training portal.
End the simulation whenever the request is unclear or you want to stop.

redFlags.title: Artificial deadline
redFlags.description: The caller makes the practice decision sound time-limited.
redFlags.safeAction: Take time to check the practice request.

redFlags.title: Claimed approval
redFlags.description: A desk name, queue, or supervisor is offered as proof of identity.
redFlags.safeAction: Use the fictional employee directory you already know.

redFlags.title: Isolation
redFlags.description: The caller suggests keeping the training request away from colleagues.
redFlags.safeAction: Consult the established training desk through your own channel.

redFlags.title: Threatened consequence
redFlags.description: A delay, hold, or removal is presented as a consequence of pausing.
redFlags.safeAction: Verify the stated consequence independently before deciding.

redFlags.title: Reward bait
redFlags.description: A practice perk is linked to accepting the request on the call.
redFlags.safeAction: Decline the offer until the familiar training channel confirms it.

examples.interpretation: Declines to confirm enrollment on the call.
Refuses to share a token without claiming verification.
Asks for time to understand the request.
Pauses to check notes without independently verifying.
Uses a channel independent of the caller.
Agrees to confirmation without disclosing a token.
Accepts the caller's suggested slot selection.
Assents to a workshop action without sharing a token.
Says the synthetic value printed on a practice card.
Reads a different explicitly synthetic value aloud.
Unrelated weather comment gives no usable decision.
Asks about format without agreeing, pausing, or verifying.
Acknowledges familiarity without expressing an action.

decisionPoints.context: Decide whether to confirm the practice enrollment on an unexpected call.
Consider whether the claimed supervisor approval independently establishes identity.
Decide whether an alleged hold changes your plan to check through a familiar channel.

details.stopGuidance: Learner End and the safe word stop the simulation immediately without another learner window.

debriefs.scoring: Credit independent verification only when the learner names a channel they already know.
debriefs.nextAction: Open the familiar employee directory yourself before confirming enrollment.
debriefs.limitations: A stated plan does not establish that an external check was completed.
debriefs.takeaway: A familiar channel separates the decision from the caller's claimed approval.

debriefs.scoring: Record an explicit refusal only when the learner states it.
debriefs.nextAction: End the call if the caller insists and check the request separately.
debriefs.limitations: Refusal alone does not establish independent verification.
debriefs.takeaway: A caller cannot require you to keep a training request private.

debriefs.scoring: Record a requested pause. Do not infer recognition from response latency.
debriefs.nextAction: Use the pause to look up the training desk through a familiar source.
debriefs.limitations: A pause alone does not establish what the learner noticed.
debriefs.takeaway: A practice deadline leaves room for an independent check.

debriefs.scoring: Record synthetic disclosure only when the structured behavior identifies the dummy pattern.
debriefs.nextAction: On the next call, decline to read a token and verify the request elsewhere.
debriefs.limitations: DUMMY-1234 jaise fictional training-only token ko bina poochhe bolna bhi synthetic disclosure hai. Yeh real credential exposure ya request par agreement establish nahi karta; simulation safely khatam hoti hai.
debriefs.takeaway: A caller's asserted authority cannot authorize token disclosure.

debriefs.scoring: Leave action-specific points unscored when the behavior is UNKNOWN.
debriefs.nextAction: End the call and check the enrollment through a familiar channel.
debriefs.limitations: An ambiguous reply cannot establish intent, compliance, or refusal.
debriefs.takeaway: An unclear request can be stopped without making a decision.

debriefs.scoring: Record bounded completion. Score verification or refusal only if present in committed events.
debriefs.nextAction: Review the enrollment separately before acting.
debriefs.limitations: Reaching the turn cap does not imply acceptance of the caller's claim.
debriefs.takeaway: The practice can end while a decision is still open.

debriefs.scoring: Record COMPLIED only when committed behavior shows agreement without a dummy value. Verification, disclosure, enrollment and transaction completion remain unscored without their own evidence. Agreement alone earns no independent-verification credit.
debriefs.nextAction: Call ko rokein. Apne familiar employee directory ya bookmarked training portal ko khud kholkar request independently check karein.
debriefs.limitations: Haan kehne se dummy disclosure, real enrollment ya transaction completion establish nahi hota. Dummy token bina kisi aur agreement ke bhi bola ja sakta hai; us observation ka label DISCLOSED_DUMMY_SECRET hai.
debriefs.takeaway: Call par haan aur token batana alag observations hain. Aage koi action lene se pehle apne known channel se verify karein.
